info.title: RBusDiagnostics API
info.description: Authorized access to bounded device-wide RBus diagnostics. Successful methods return a bounded reporter-generated JSON object in reporterPayload. Reporter communication failures return REPORTER_UNAVAILABLE (-32070).

getGlobalMetrics.summary: Returns the bounded global reporter snapshot.

reporterPayload.description: Bounded reporter-generated JSON object containing global operation metrics and quality metadata.

getProviderMetrics.summary: Returns bounded metrics for one retained provider.

reporterPayload.description: Bounded reporter-generated JSON object for the requested provider.

getAllProviders.summary: Returns up to the requested bounded number of provider records.

reporterPayload.description: Bounded reporter-generated JSON object containing no more than the requested number of provider records.

getSlowRequests.summary: Returns up to the requested bounded number of retained slow requests.

reporterPayload.description: Bounded reporter-generated JSON object containing no more than the requested retained slow requests.

resetMetrics.summary: Atomically starts a new reporter measurement generation.

reporterPayload.description: Bounded reporter-generated JSON object containing the committed measurement generation.

errors.description: The local reporter is absent, incompatible, disconnected, malformed, or timed out.
The requested provider is not retained by the reporter.
